component.name: WXB Studio
component.summary: Autoclicker, rotation macro and SOCD cleaner for Linux

description.p: WXB Studio is a GTK4 control room for Linux input work: an autoclicker with range and delay controls, a Roblox rotation macro, an SOCD cleaner with an optional Input Lab, macro recording and playback, an X11 screen recorder, and Cordial/Nightcap alt management.
It runs unprivileged for clicking and hotkeys. SOCD device access is granted by the desktop session; the application never asks for your password.
Write release checksums with portable file names.
